resources.string: An independent app for the Norm 2.
Norm+ keeps your watch connected, brings your phone\'s notifications and calls to your wrist, and shows the steps, heart rate and sleep your watch has counted. It is not made by the watch\'s maker.
Norm+ talks to your watch over Bluetooth. Android calls this permission Nearby devices. It is the only one Norm+ needs: everything after it can be skipped.
Norm+ can\'t reach your watch without it
Allow Nearby devices to go on. If Android no longer asks, Allow opens Norm+\'s settings: turn on Nearby devices under Permissions.
No watch found. Wake your watch, keep it close to the phone, and make sure no other phone or app is connected to it.
Android\'s Bluetooth did not start the scan. Try again in a moment.
On the watch, Settings → About shows its address and a QR code. Type the address, or paste the QR code\'s text.
That isn\'t an address. It looks like 4C:59:80:12:44:F1.
Connecting takes up to about 10 seconds, and sometimes more than one try. Keep the watch close.
Android will ask to pair with %1$s
Tap Pair. The request closes after 30 seconds.
Pair wasn\'t tapped within 30 seconds, or the request was cancelled. Try again, and Android asks once more.
Keep the watch close, and make sure no other phone or app is connected to it. Turning Bluetooth off and on usually helps.
Your watch shows “Pairing Success”, then its face.
Your watch was already set up
Your watch didn\'t finish setting up
If it shows “Pairing Failed”, that clears by itself in a moment. Try again, or go on: Norm+ stays connected either way.
Norm+ keeps one quiet notification while it holds the connection, and uses it to say when something needs fixing.
Norm+\'s notifications are off. You can turn them on later from Watch.
To pass your phone\'s notifications to the watch, Norm+ needs notification access. Android opens its settings: turn on Norm+ there, then come back.
If Android says it is a restricted setting, open Norm+\'s App info, tap ⋮ and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Notification access is off, so nothing reaches the watch yet. You can turn it on later from Watch.
Only the apps you choose reach your watch. You can change them any time from Watch.
Your watch can show who is calling, and answer or decline. For that Android asks for phone, call log and contacts. Without them everything else still works.
Calls won\'t reach your watch. You can allow them later from Watch.
Keep Norm+ running in the background
Android pauses apps to save battery, and a paused Norm+ loses the watch. Letting it run keeps the watch connected all day.
Norm+ may be paused in the background. You can allow it later from Watch.
